title.en: Bored lever or knob set (ANSI/BHMA A156.2)
title.zh: 开孔式把手锁 / 球形锁（ANSI/BHMA A156.2）

summary.en: Two bores: a 2-1/8 in cross bore through the face for the knob, and an edge bore for the latch. Dimensions are so consistent that a retrofit can be designed blind — backset 2-3/8 in or 2-3/4 in covers almost everything.
summary.zh: 两个孔：门面 2-1/8 英寸横孔装把手，门边孔装斜舌。尺寸高度一致，改造可以“盲设计”——背距 2-3/8 或 2-3/4 英寸几乎覆盖所有情况。

en: Latch assembly in the edge bore, with a 2-1/4 × 1-1/8 in faceplate on residential sets
Tailpiece connecting the outside trim to the chassis
Cylinder in the outside knob or lever, or a separate deadbolt above
zh: 边孔内的斜舌组件，住宅常用 2-1/4 × 1-1/8 英寸面板
连接外侧饰件与锁机的尾片
锁芯位于外侧把手内，或在其上方另设插销

measurements.typical: 2-3/8 in (60 mm) residential, 2-3/4 in (70 mm) exterior and commercial

how.en: Door edge to the centre of the 2-1/8 in bore.
how.zh: 门边到 2-1/8 英寸横孔中心。

how.en: Measure across the round hole in the door face.
Measure the hole in the door edge.

notes.en: Two very different retrofits live here. On a lockset with a key in the knob, you replace the whole set with a smart lockset on the same bores. Where there is a separate deadbolt above, the cheap and reliable answer is a motor on the deadbolt's turn-piece instead.
notes.zh: 这里有两条完全不同的改造路线。如果把手里带钥匙，就用同孔位的智能把手锁整体替换；如果上方另有一把插销，那么更便宜可靠的做法是给插销旋钮加电机。

en.a: The highest ANSI/BHMA durability grade. For bored locksets Allegion lists 1,000,000 cycles at Grade 1; other published tables give 800,000. Cite the edition when you use the number.

en.q: Can I just swap the outside knob?
en.a: Usually no — chassis and tailpiece geometry differ between makers even when the bores match.

zh.a: ANSI/BHMA 最高耐久等级。开孔式锁具 Allegion 给出的 Grade 1 为 1,000,000 次循环；另有公开表格给出 800,000 次。引用数字时请注明标准版本。
通常不行——即使孔位相同，不同厂商的锁机与尾片几何也不同。
